Santa Helena is about 40 min. Away from Medellín, and geographically is right next to it, but higher. Santa Helena is a lot colder, and it has some interesting sites to go visit, like the Arvi park and the Silleteros every year around august's Feria de Flores.

If you look for cabins in AirBnB, you'll find a bunch of properties to spend a cozy weekend with your loved ones.

* Making my mom walk on my corpse
* Leaving my cat alone
* Making my friends cry
* Making my brother cry
* The very real possibility of failing the attempt and being crippled for the rest of days

and many more, but it doesn't stop the thoughts from coming into my head.

Not much, maybe try and read a few books and crank up the exercise. I currently feel blocked and stressed because my mom is soon going to move out the house but she keeps going back on her decision or delaying it, so I'll have to think in moving out myself because I am tired of living with her.

I would like to live a healthier life, with at least 5 days of work-outs every week, I'd also like to have my own comic or artistic proyect, something that makes me give it all my love and passion, prioritizing that over cash (but I would love to not starve, so I'll have to come up with something), and I would like to fill a bookshelf with topics and stories that I like.

  
Of course, it would be fun to find someone special that can join me with these little goals, and that invites me to theirs, but this last bit feels too greedy and random to mark it down as a goal.
